text:
We’re getting married soon, and we’re both citizens of the country where we’ll be getting married. I saw that I need to notify the Israeli authorities within 30 days of the change in my marital status, but I won’t be able to return to Israel within that time. 

I also saw that a document confirming our marital status is required among the initial documents for processing the application. How can we obtain this document if registering the marriage in Israel requires both spouses to be present, but she doesn’t even have permission to enter Israel?
